name: Monstrous Love
source:
Three short interactive stories about women exploring their sexuality and becoming intimate with ravenous and gentle monsters. Welcome to a world of sensuality, freedom, and love!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2011410/Monstrous_Love/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
三则互动短篇，讲述女性探索自身情欲，与既贪婪又温柔的怪物亲密相处的故事。欢迎来到一个充满感官享受、自由与爱的世界！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2011410/Monstrous_Love/]Steam[/url]]
